entries.zh: 追赶以便捉住它；执捉，拿住
entries.en: to pursue in order to catch and seize it; to lay hold of
entries.notes: 音写尾段 siõ 之标号污损存疑（T99），据西语「追而捕之」与「執」字定为擒捉义

entries.zh: 跟随；顺从；陪同
entries.en: to follow; to obey/comply with; to accompany
entries.notes: 西语 obedecer 拼写存疑；音写尾段（guan su voitlad…）污损难辨（T99），仅据「隨遂」与前段定义

entries.zh: 从其所欲；随其意愿
entries.en: to follow one's own will; to do as one pleases
entries.notes: 汉字栏空，闽南语栏仅存 Sui（隨）、其后涂黑残损，据西语定义并参上条隨遂义补

entries.zh: 顺从长上之命；顺，顺受
entries.en: to obey and submit to the superior's command
entries.notes: 缩写 Sup.or 展开为 Superior 系推断；音写尾段残损（T99）

entries.zh: 徇从（上司）之意；徇，曲从
entries.en: to comply with (the superior's) will; to yield to another's wishes
entries.notes: 西语中夹墨渍、音写双点似涂改，两处残损仅存 Sun..，据西语定义与「徇」字补

entries.zh: 遵循古教旧法：善则从之，不善则不从
entries.en: to follow the old doctrine if good, and not if bad; to cling to tradition
entries.notes: 汉字「古/拙/傳」难辨，音写 coi-chuan 拟「古傳」义，标号污损（T99）；西语 antigua 拼写存疑

entries.zh: 跟寻：追寻某物
entries.en: to go after something in search of it; to pursue

entries.zh: 鲁莽地追赶；一味穷追
entries.en: to pursue something recklessly; to chase headlong
entries.notes: 西语似 temerariamente（推断）；汉字两处存疑（残/淺、赶/趕）、音写污损（T99），据西语定义定鲁莽追赶义

entries.zh: 找去：追去把它取来、捉住
entries.en: to go after it in order to get or catch it
entries.notes: 缩写 p.a=para；汉字「請/青」存疑，音写 che-cu 拟「找去」义，首标号污损（T99）

entries.zh: 执着伊：把它/他捉拿住
entries.en: to seize and hold it/him; to lay hold of him
entries.notes: 缩写 p.a=para 展开系推断；「着/著」为同字异体，不影响释义

entries.zh: 从古来：遵从古来的传统旧教
entries.en: to follow the old traditions and doctrines handed down from antiquity
entries.notes: 音写尾端另有小字迹残损；「来/來」为繁简异体

entries.zh: 从头来：从头开始，自始照行
entries.en: to follow from the very beginning; to start over from the top
entries.notes: 「来/來」为同字繁简异体，不影响释义

entries.zh: 从吾所好：依从自己的喜好意愿
entries.en: to follow one's own liking and will
entries.notes: 音写尾端 suy 之后涂改残损，主体 chiong-gou-sou-ho（从吾所好）清晰

entries.zh: 拗僻：任性固执，一味依己意
entries.en: to be wilfully perverse, insisting on one's own way
entries.notes: 「拗/拘」「僻/辟」存疑，后接涂改字组残损，据西语「从己意」与音写 au-pia 拟

entries.zh: 从新：趋新，追赶新奇
entries.en: to follow novelties; to chase whatever is new

entries.zh: 冲前阵：冲在队伍前头，随同伴前进不后退
entries.en: to push ahead at the front of the rank, following one's comrade without turning back
entries.notes: 西语 deene 疑为 delante（在前）系推断；「陣/阵」为同字异体，音写 tin 正合「陣」

entries.zh: 执着（捉）不着：追而捉他不住
entries.en: to chase and fail to catch him; to come up empty
entries.notes: 「着/著」为同字异体，不影响释义

entries.zh: 循迹追寻：沿脚印踪迹追踪
entries.en: to follow by the footprints; to trail, track someone
entries.notes: 「捞/拉」两可，据西语「循足迹」与音写 la-chue 定循踪追寻义

entries.zh: 涉蹈：蹈袭他人成说，随人步趋
entries.en: to follow another's opinion; to tread in another's steps

entries.zh: 趁青春：少年趁年少随己所好
entries.en: to follow one's pleasures while young; to make the most of one's youth

entries.zh: 趁少年（趁后生）：趁年少及时行乐
entries.en: to make the most of one's youth; to follow one's pleasures while still young
entries.notes: 音写尾段 iõ 之鼻化钩/花笔存疑，主体 tan-sian-lian（趁少年）清晰
